prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a new HAVENLINE World 1 upgrade-design proposal sheet, using the supplied selected base image(s) as immutable design-family references. Premium chunky rounded stylized 3D mobile-game art, warm orange timber, navy/blue painted metal, rounded steel brackets, light sculpted snow, clean navy studio background. Two authored appearance proposals, NOT numeric equipment levels and NOT unlocks: top row REINFORCED; bottom row ADVANCED. Exact 2-row by 3-column board. Each row depicts the SAME object consistently in front three-quarter, rear three-quarter, and close functional side/detail view. Six clear roomy panels, identical design features across that row, neutral studio lighting. Header HAVENLINE / WORLD 1 / SELF-SERVICE COUNTER. Small subtitle APPEARANCE STUDY. Short labels only. No level numbers, costs, stats, new recipes, characters, HUD, watermarks, decorative clutter, giant growth, or giant resource models. Upgrades must be visually meaningful through engineered reinforcements and material improvements, remain recognizably the selected original, and retain compact footprint, input/output positions, service clearances and underlying purpose. These are authored concept designs, not observed reference-video claims. Do not redraw the retained base as an extra tier.
Reference1 is only the approved chunky rectangular timber table/leg silhouette. Its cash register is OBSOLETE and must be completely absent. Reference2 controls CURRENT self-service and accepted small goods/cash scale. Keep table height and width unchanged. Customer front remains completely open and reachable, worker rear remains accessible. Leave two plainly separated tabletop zones: useful stacks of processed goods toward delivery end, physically separate small green cash bundles on opposite end. No cashier or register of any kind. Top row: reinforced wooden counter with rounded steel corner straps, supported feet, tidy shallow stock dividers. Bottom row: developed sturdy counter with blue lower armor inserts, smooth orange timber top, stronger underframe, same width/height, same separate cash surface. Keep product/cash zones on the same physical ends across rotated views. No roof, no canopy, no extra machine, no payment terminal. A short disconnected orange belt docking lip may be shown at stock end only, maintaining the existing slim width; do not create a new belt design.
